zh: 这些药你要坚持吃下去。
py: zhè xiē yào nǐ yào jiān chí chī xià qù
en: You need to keep taking these medicines.
why: 吃下去 means carry on from now, and the object is fronted as a topic since 下去 takes no object after it: 吃下去这些药 is wrong.

q: 医生让他戴___口罩。
zh: 医生让他戴上口罩。
py: yī shēng ràng tā dài shàng kǒu zhào
en: The doctor told him to put on a mask.
why: Putting something on is 戴上. 戴过 would mean having worn one before, which does not fit an instruction.

q: 这份工作太累了，我真不想再这样干___了。
zh: 这份工作太累了，我真不想再这样干下去了。
py: zhè fèn gōng zuò tài lèi le wǒ zhēn bù xiǎng zài zhè yàng gàn xià qù le
en: This job is too tiring; I really don't want to carry on like this any more.
why: Carrying on from now is 干下去, and 再这样 sets up the 'if it continues' sense. 下来 would describe something already completed.

zh: 请把病历带来。
py: qǐng bǎ bìng lì dài lái
en: Please bring the medical record.
why: 把 and its object come before the verb, and 带来 stays together at the end. 带来把病历 puts the object after the complement.

q: 他变化太大了，我都没认___他来。
zh: 他变化太大了，我都没认出他来。
py: tā biàn huà tài dà le wǒ dōu méi rèn chū tā lái
en: He has changed so much that I didn't recognise him.
why: Recognising someone is 认出 (他) 来, with the person between 出 and 来. 认起, 认下 and 认上 are not used.

s: 我一定要学下去汉语。
s_py: wǒ yī dìng yào xué xià qù hàn yǔ
zh: 我一定要把汉语学下去。
py: wǒ yī dìng yào bǎ hàn yǔ xué xià qù
en: I'm definitely going to keep studying Chinese.
why: 下去 takes no object after it. Move the object in front of the verb (把汉语学下去) or the sentence breaks.

q: 检查做完了吗？做完了你就下___吧，我在一楼。
zh: 检查做完了吗？做完了你就下来吧，我在一楼。
py: jiǎn chá zuò wán le ma zuò wán le nǐ jiù xià lái ba wǒ zài yī lóu
en: Is the check-up finished? If so, come down; I'm on the ground floor.
why: I am waiting on the ground floor, so coming down ends near me: 下来. 下去 would send the listener away from where I stand.

q: 医生说的话，你最好都记___，回家再看。
zh: 医生说的话，你最好都记下来，回家再看。
py: yī shēng shuō de huà nǐ zuì hǎo dōu jì xià lái huí jiā zài kàn
en: You'd better note down everything the doctor says so you can read it at home.
why: Fixing words on paper is 记下来. 记起来 would mean you suddenly remember, which does not fit reading it at home later.

q: 这个新药看___很普通，可是特别有效。
zh: 这个新药看起来很普通，可是特别有效。
py: zhè ge xīn yào kàn qǐ lái hěn pǔ tōng kě shì tè bié yǒu xiào
en: This new medicine looks very ordinary, but it's especially effective.
why: An impression is 看起来 + comment. 看出来 means you worked something out, and it cannot be followed by a plain comment like 很普通.

q: 他没说名字，可是我一听就听___他是谁了。
zh: 他没说名字，可是我一听就听出来他是谁了。
py: tā méi shuō míng zi kě shì wǒ yī tīng jiù tīng chū lái tā shì shéi le
en: He didn't give his name, but I could tell who he was as soon as I heard him.
why: Identifying something hidden by listening is 听出来. 听起来 gives an impression ('it sounds like') and cannot take a clause like 他是谁.

src: 我一听声音，就知道是李医生。
src_py: wǒ yī tīng shēng yīn jiù zhī dào shì lǐ yī shēng
task: Say you could tell by listening (use 听出来).
zh: 我一听就听出来是李医生。
py: wǒ yī tīng jiù tīng chū lái shì lǐ yī shēng
en: The moment I listened I could tell it was Dr Li.
why: Working out who it is by listening is 听出来. 听起来 would mean 'it sounds like' and does not fit 一听就.

zh: 他把窗户关上了。
py: tā bǎ chuāng hu guān shàng le
en: He closed the window.
why: 把 puts the window before the verb, 关上 keeps its complement and 了 comes last. 关上来 would add a direction that does not fit.

s: 医生从包里拿出来一支笔。
s_py: yī shēng cóng bāo lǐ ná chū lái yī zhī bǐ
zh: 医生从包里拿出来一支笔。
py: yī shēng cóng bāo lǐ ná chū lái yī zhī bǐ
en: The doctor took a pen out of his bag.
why: A thing object may follow 来 when the action has happened: 拿出来一支笔 is as good as 拿出一支笔来.

q: 你到了就直接上___吧，我在三楼办公室。
zh: 你到了就直接上来吧，我在三楼办公室。
py: nǐ dào le jiù zhí jiē shàng lái ba wǒ zài sān lóu bàn gōng shì
en: When you arrive, just come straight up; I'm in the third-floor office.
why: I am upstairs, so going up ends where I am: 上来. 上去 would be said by someone standing below, not at the destination.

q: 孩子打了针以后，慢慢安静___了。
zh: 孩子打了针以后，慢慢安静下来了。
py: hái zi dǎ le zhēn yǐ hòu màn màn ān jìng xià lái le
en: After the injection the child slowly calmed down.
why: Calming down is a settling change, so 下来: 安静下来. 下去 would mean staying quiet from now on, and 上去 sends something upward.

s: 经理一进来，大家就安静上来了。
s_py: jīng lǐ yī jìn lái dà jiā jiù ān jìng shàng lái le
zh: 经理一进来，大家就安静下来了。
py: jīng lǐ yī jìn lái dà jiā jiù ān jìng xià lái le
en: The moment the manager came in, everyone quietened down.
why: Going quiet settles downward: 安静下来. 上来 means coming up and cannot describe becoming quiet.

q: 我在一楼大厅，经理从三楼走下___了。
zh: 我在一楼大厅，经理从三楼走下楼来了。
py: wǒ zài yī lóu dà tīng jīng lǐ cóng sān lóu zǒu xià lóu lái le
en: I'm in the ground-floor hall; the manager has come down from the third floor.
why: 走下楼来: the place 楼 sits between 下 and 来. I am downstairs, so toward me is 来, and 来楼 or 去楼 would put the place after the direction.

s: 他从大楼里走出来，坐上了出租车。
s_py: tā cóng dà lóu lǐ zǒu chū lái zuò shàng le chū zū chē
zh: 他从大楼里走出来，坐上了出租车。
py: tā cóng dà lóu lǐ zǒu chū lái zuò shàng le chū zū chē
en: He walked out of the building and got into a taxi.
why: 坐上 is getting into a vehicle, with 了 after 上 and no 来/去. 走出来 shows the first movement out of the building.

q: 手机掉在地上了，请帮我捡___来。
zh: 手机掉在地上了，请帮我捡起来。
py: shǒu jī diào zài dì shàng le qǐng bāng wǒ jiǎn qǐ lái
en: My phone dropped on the floor; please pick it up for me.
why: Lifting something off the floor is 捡起来. 上 would mean bringing it up from a lower level, and 下 and 进 point the wrong way.

src_py: wǒ dài lái le nà fèn zī liào
zh: 我把那份资料带来了。
py: wǒ bǎ nà fèn zī liào dài lái le
en: I brought that file.
why: A specific object (那份资料) fits 把: it goes before the verb and 带来 plus 了 stay at the end.

q: 医生说他的病不重，可以留___观察一天。
zh: 医生说他的病不重，可以留下来观察一天。
py: yī shēng shuō tā de bìng bú zhòng kě yǐ liú xià lái guān chá yī tiān
en: The doctor said his illness isn't serious and he can stay for a day of observation.
why: Staying put is 留下来. 起来 would mean something starts, and 留出来 would mean setting something aside.

task: Add 去 to say he has gone home.
zh: 他回家去了。
py: tā huí jiā qù le
en: He has gone home.
why: The place 家 sits before 去 and 了 closes the sentence. 回去家 puts the place after 去.

q: 你可以把这份表格从网上___吗？
zh: 你可以把这份表格从网上下载下来吗？
py: nǐ kě yǐ bǎ zhè fèn biǎo gé cóng wǎng shàng xià zǎi xià lái ma
en: Can you download this form from the internet?
why: Saving something to your own device is 下载下来: it comes to rest with you. 起来 would mean starting to download and 下去 continuing.

s: 我想了很久，才想起来他的名字。
s_py: wǒ xiǎng le hěn jiǔ cái xiǎng qǐ lái tā de míng zi
zh: 我想了很久，才想起来他的名字。
py: wǒ xiǎng le hěn jiǔ cái xiǎng qǐ lái tā de míng zi
en: I thought for a long time before I remembered his name.
why: A name you once knew is recalled with 想起来, with the object after 来. 想出来 is for inventing something new.

s: 听到这个好消息，他高兴得跳起了。
s_py: tīng dào zhè ge hǎo xiāo xi tā gāo xìng de tiào qǐ le
zh: 听到这个好消息，他高兴得跳起来了。
py: tīng dào zhè ge hǎo xiāo xi tā gāo xìng de tiào qǐ lái le
en: Hearing the good news, he jumped up with joy.
why: 起 needs 来 to complete it: 跳起来. Leaving 来 out and ending with 起了 is incomplete.

q: 你把那把椅子拿___，我想坐一会儿。
zh: 你把那把椅子拿过来，我想坐一会儿。
py: nǐ bǎ nà bǎ yǐ zi ná guò lái wǒ xiǎng zuò yī huì r
en: Bring that chair over here; I'd like to sit for a while.
why: Bringing something across to the speaker is 拿过来. 拿起来 only lifts it, and 拿下去 or 拿出去 carry it away from me.

zh: 同事从楼上跑下来了。
py: tóng shì cóng lóu shàng pǎo xià lái le
en: My colleague has run down from upstairs.
why: From a higher floor to the speaker below is 下来, kept together after the verb: 跑下来. 跑来下 reverses the parts.

s: 天冷，你把外套穿起吧。
s_py: tiān lěng nǐ bǎ wài tào chuān qǐ ba
zh: 天冷，你把外套穿上吧。
py: tiān lěng nǐ bǎ wài tào chuān shàng ba
en: It's cold, put your coat on.
why: Putting on clothes is 穿上. 起 only appears with 来 (穿起来) and cannot end the verb alone.

q: 听了经理的话，大家都笑___了。
zh: 听了经理的话，大家都笑起来了。
py: tīng le jīng lǐ de huà dà jiā dōu xiào qǐ lái le
en: Hearing the manager's words, everyone started to laugh.
why: Verb + 起来 marks the start of an action: 笑起来. 下去 would be carrying on, and 下来 means settling down.

q: 我现在在医院，医生要看病历，可我没把病历带___。
zh: 我现在在医院，医生要看病历，可我没把病历带来。
py: wǒ xiàn zài zài yī yuàn yī shēng yào kàn bìng lì kě wǒ méi bǎ bìng lì dài lái
en: I'm at the hospital and the doctor wants to see my record, but I didn't bring it.
why: 没 goes before 把, and the verb keeps its direction: 带来. The record should have come to where I am now, so 来, not 去.

s: 你的脸色看出来很不好。
s_py: nǐ de liǎn sè kàn chū lái hěn bù hǎo
zh: 你的脸色看起来很不好。
py: nǐ de liǎn sè kàn qǐ lái hěn bù hǎo
en: Your complexion looks very bad.
why: An impression followed by a comment is 看起来. 看出来 means you worked something out, so the comment 很不好 cannot follow it.

q: 你天天熬夜，再这样___，身体会出问题的。
zh: 你天天熬夜，再这样下去，身体会出问题的。
py: nǐ tiān tiān áo yè zài zhè yàng xià qù shēn tǐ huì chū wèn tí de
en: You stay up late every day; if this goes on, your health will suffer.
why: 再这样下去 is the fixed phrase for 'if it carries on like this': 下去 continues from now on. 下来 looks back at something finished.

s: 听到这个消息，他慢慢冷静下来了。
s_py: tīng dào zhè ge xiāo xi tā màn màn lěng jìng xià lái le
zh: 听到这个消息，他慢慢冷静下来了。
py: tīng dào zhè ge xiāo xi tā màn màn lěng jìng xià lái le
en: Hearing the news, he gradually calmed down.
why: Calming down is a settling change, so 下来. 冷静起来 would sound like becoming cool-headed from nothing.

src_py: bìng rén màn màn ān jìng le
task: Say he settled down (use 下来).
zh: 病人慢慢安静下来了。
py: bìng rén màn màn ān jìng xià lái le
en: The patient gradually quietened down.
why: Calming down settles downward: 安静下来. 安静起来 would sound like something starting up.

src_py: hù shi bǎ shuǐ duān guò lái le
task: Turn it into a polite request.
zh: 请你把水端过来。
py: qǐng nǐ bǎ shuǐ duān guò lái
en: Please bring the water over.
why: A request keeps the 把 structure with 请 in front, and 了 is dropped because nothing has happened yet.

src_py: tā ná chū bìng lì lái le
zh: 他把病历拿出来了。
py: tā bǎ bìng lì ná chū lái le
en: He took out the medical record.
why: 把 moves 病历 before the verb, and 拿出来 stays together with 了 last. The 来 no longer has to split the verb from its object.

q: 同事从北京给我带___一些药。
zh: 同事从北京给我带来了一些药。
py: tóng shì cóng běi jīng gěi wǒ dài lái le yī xiē yào
en: A colleague brought me some medicine from Beijing.
why: 来 follows the verb directly and 了 comes after it: 带来了一些药. 带了来 reverses them, and 去 points away from me although the medicine came to me.

q: 他把写错的字改___了。
zh: 他把写错的字改过来了。
py: tā bǎ xiě cuò de zì gǎi guò lái le
en: He corrected the characters he'd written wrongly.
why: Putting something right is 改过来: 过来 also means back to the correct state. 改起来 would mean starting to change it.

q: 请你把办公室的门关___。
zh: 请你把办公室的门关上。
py: qǐng nǐ bǎ bàn gōng shì de mén guān shàng
en: Please close the office door.
why: Shutting something is 关上: 上 means two things come together. 关出, 关进 and 关过 do not mean closing a door.

s: 护士把病人从床上扶起来了。
s_py: hù shi bǎ bìng rén cóng chuáng shàng fú qǐ lái le
zh: 护士把病人从床上扶起来了。
py: hù shi bǎ bìng rén cóng chuáng shàng fú qǐ lái le
en: The nurse helped the patient up from the bed.
why: 把 puts the patient before the verb, and 起来 stays attached to 扶 at the end: raising someone up from lying.

zh: 他把体检报告拿上楼去了。
py: tā bǎ tǐ jiǎn bào gào ná shàng lóu qù le
en: He took the check-up report upstairs.
why: In a 把 sentence the place still goes between 上 and 去: 拿上楼去了. 拿上去楼 puts it after 去.

q: 病人在三楼病房，我是一楼的护士，我现在就上___看他。
zh: 病人在三楼病房，我是一楼的护士，我现在就上去看他。
py: bìng rén zài sān lóu bìng fáng wǒ shì yī lóu de hù shi wǒ xiàn zài jiù shàng qù kàn tā
en: The patient is in the third-floor ward and I'm a nurse on the ground floor, so I'm going up to see him now.
why: I am on the ground floor and the ward is above, so I move away from my own spot: 上去. 上来 needs the speaker to be upstairs.

q: 你累了就先停___，休息一下再走。
zh: 你累了就先停下来，休息一下再走。
py: nǐ lèi le jiù xiān tíng xià lái xiū xi yī xià zài zǒu
en: If you're tired, stop for a moment and rest before going on.
why: Coming to a halt is 停下来. 下去 means continuing, which contradicts resting, and 起来 means starting.

s: 外面突然下雨起来了。
s_py: wài miàn tū rán xià yǔ qǐ lái le
zh: 外面突然下起雨来了。
py: wài miàn tū rán xià qǐ yǔ lái le
en: It suddenly started raining outside.
why: With 起来 'start' the object goes inside: 下起雨来. Putting 雨 before 起来 is the classic mistake.

q: 他考___了医科大学，想当医生。
zh: 他考上了医科大学，想当医生。
py: tā kǎo shàng le yī kē dà xué xiǎng dāng yī shēng
en: He got into medical university and wants to be a doctor.
why: Reaching a goal such as a place at university is 考上. 考出 and 考起 do not carry that meaning, and 考下 is not used for exams.

q: 护士说，病人睡了一整天才醒___。
zh: 护士说，病人睡了一整天才醒过来。
py: hù shi shuō bìng rén shuì le yī zhěng tiān cái xǐng guò lái
en: The nurse said the patient slept a whole day before waking up.
why: Coming back to consciousness is 醒过来: 过来 means returning to a normal state. 醒起来 is not a word.

q: 运动以后，他的心跳快___了。
zh: 运动以后，他的心跳快起来了。
py: yùn dòng yǐ hòu tā de xīn tiào kuài qǐ lái le
en: After exercising, his heartbeat started to speed up.
why: Speeding up is something that picks up: 快起来. 下来 is for slowing or settling down, which is the opposite of 快.

zh: 他走进办公室来了。
py: tā zǒu jìn bàn gōng shì lái le
en: He has walked into the office.
why: The place 办公室 sits between 走进 and 来, and 来 closes the phrase. 走进来办公室 puts the place after 来, which is wrong.

s: 他走进办公室了。
s_py: tā zǒu jìn bàn gōng shì le
zh: 他走进办公室了。
py: tā zǒu jìn bàn gōng shì le
en: He walked into the office.
why: With a place object 来/去 is optional, so 走进办公室 is complete. The real mistake would be 走进来办公室, not leaving 来 out.

q: 我在办公室等你，你把体检报告拿___吧。
zh: 我在办公室等你，你把体检报告拿进来吧。
py: wǒ zài bàn gōng shì děng nǐ nǐ bǎ tǐ jiǎn bào gào ná jìn lái ba
en: I'm waiting in the office; bring the check-up report in.
why: 把 + thing + verb + direction + 来/去. The report comes into the office where I am, so 进来. 出去, 上去 and 下去 all send it away.

s: 我把手机没带来。
s_py: wǒ bǎ shǒu jī méi dài lái
zh: 我没把手机带来。
py: wǒ méi bǎ shǒu jī dài lái
en: I didn't bring my phone.
why: 没 must go before 把, never between 把 and the verb.

s: 他从三楼走来下了。
s_py: tā cóng sān lóu zǒu lái xià le
zh: 他从三楼走下来了。
py: tā cóng sān lóu zǒu xià lái le
en: He walked down from the third floor.
why: The order is verb + direction + 来: 走下来. 来 can never come before the direction word 下.

q: 我在楼下，经理在楼上叫你，你快上___吧。
zh: 我在楼下，经理在楼上叫你，你快上去吧。
py: wǒ zài lóu xià jīng lǐ zài lóu shàng jiào nǐ nǐ kuài shàng qù ba
en: I'm downstairs and the manager is upstairs asking for you, so go up quickly.
why: I stay downstairs and the listener goes up to the manager, away from me: 上去. 上来 would need the speaker to be at the top.

q: 外面下___雨来了，我们快回办公室吧。
zh: 外面下起雨来了，我们快回办公室吧。
py: wài miàn xià qǐ yǔ lái le wǒ men kuài huí bàn gōng shì ba
en: It's started raining outside; let's get back to the office quickly.
why: With 起来 'start', the object goes inside: 下起雨来. 下上雨来 and 下出雨来 do not exist.

zh: 同事向我走过来了。
py: tóng shì xiàng wǒ zǒu guò lái le
en: My colleague has walked over towards me.
why: 过来 is across the space toward the speaker, and 向我 comes before the verb. 走来过 reverses the complement.

zh: 孩子哭起来了。
py: hái zi kū qǐ lái le
en: The child started crying.
why: Verb + 起来 shows an action starting, with 了 at the end for the new situation.

q: 药店在马路对面，我现在走___买药。
zh: 药店在马路对面，我现在走过去买药。
py: yào diàn zài mǎ lù duì miàn wǒ xiàn zài zǒu guò qù mǎi yào
en: The pharmacy is across the road; I'm going over now to buy medicine.
why: The pharmacy is on the far side from me, so crossing is away from me: 过去. 过来 would be coming toward me, and 起来 or 下来 do not cross anything.

q: 吃了药以后，他的病慢慢好___了。
zh: 吃了药以后，他的病慢慢好起来了。
py: chī le yào yǐ hòu tā de bìng màn màn hǎo qǐ lái le
en: After taking the medicine, he slowly started to get better.
why: Something beginning to improve is 好起来: 起来 fits things that pick up. 下来 is for settling or slowing down, the opposite direction.

q: 大家都在北京等你，你什么时候回___？
zh: 大家都在北京等你，你什么时候回北京来？
py: dà jiā dōu zài běi jīng děng nǐ nǐ shén me shí hou huí běi jīng lái
en: Everyone is waiting for you in Beijing; when are you coming back to Beijing?
why: The speaker is in Beijing, so the return is toward us: 回北京来, with the place before 来. 回来北京 is the classic wrong order.

zh: 经理让同事把资料送进会议室去。
py: jīng lǐ ràng tóng shì bǎ zī liào sòng jìn huì yì shì qù
en: The manager asked a colleague to take the files into the meeting room.
why: The 把 phrase sits before 送进, and the place 会议室 comes before 去: 送进会议室去. 送进去会议室 is wrong.

q: 我在医院等你，明天请带一本病历___吧。
zh: 我在医院等你，明天请带一本病历来吧。
py: wǒ zài yī yuàn děng nǐ míng tiān qǐng dài yī běn bìng lì lái ba
en: I'll be waiting at the hospital; please bring a medical record tomorrow.
why: A request puts the thing before the direction: 带一本病历来. I am at the hospital, so toward me is 来, not 去.

q: 你看___他今天不太舒服吗？
zh: 你看出来他今天不太舒服吗？
py: nǐ kàn chū lái tā jīn tiān bú tài shū fu ma
en: Can you tell he isn't feeling very well today?
why: Noticing something by looking is 看出来. 看起来 would be an impression and cannot follow 你 with a clause like this.

s: 你快站起去，经理来了。
s_py: nǐ kuài zhàn qǐ qù jīng lǐ lái le
zh: 你快站起来，经理来了。
py: nǐ kuài zhàn qǐ lái jīng lǐ lái le
en: Stand up quickly, the manager is here.
why: 起 only combines with 来, so 'stand up' is 站起来. 起去 does not exist.

q: 我站在走廊里，看着她推开门，走进___了。
zh: 我站在走廊里，看着她推开门，走进诊室去了。
py: wǒ zhàn zài zǒu láng lǐ kàn zhe tā tuī kāi mén zǒu jìn zhěn shì qù le
en: Standing in the corridor, I watched her push the door open and go into the consulting room.
why: I stay in the corridor and she goes in, away from me: 走进诊室去. The place sits before 去, and 来 would need me to be inside the room.

q: 他被针扎了一下，疼得从椅子上跳___来。
zh: 他被针扎了一下，疼得从椅子上跳起来。
py: tā bèi zhēn zhā le yī xià téng de cóng yǐ zi shàng tiào qǐ lái
en: He was jabbed by the needle and jumped up from the chair in pain.
why: Jumping up on the spot is 跳起来. 跳上来 means jumping up onto something, and 跳下来 would be jumping down.

q: 经理一说话，吵闹的会议室一下子就静___了。
zh: 经理一说话，吵闹的会议室一下子就静下来了。
py: jīng lǐ yī shuō huà chǎo nào de huì yì shì yī xià zi jiù jìng xià lái le
en: The moment the manager spoke, the noisy meeting room fell quiet.
why: Noise dying away is a settling change: 静下来. 静起来 is not used for going quiet, and 下去 would mean it stays quiet from now on.

zh: 输液结束后他慢慢坐起来了。
py: shū yè jié shù hòu tā màn màn zuò qǐ lái le
en: After the drip finished, he slowly sat up.
why: Sitting up from lying down is 坐起来. 坐下来 means sitting down from standing, and the adverb 慢慢 stays before the verb.

zh: 这个办法是他想出来的。
py: zhè ge bàn fǎ shì tā xiǎng chū lái de
en: He is the one who came up with this idea.
why: 想出来 is thinking up something new, in the 是……的 frame. 想起来 would be remembering something already known.

zh: 窗外下起雨来了。
py: chuāng wài xià qǐ yǔ lái le
en: It has started to rain outside the window.
why: With 起来 'start', the object 雨 goes inside it: 下起雨来. 下雨起来 leaves the object outside.

zh: 她考上了北京大学。
py: tā kǎo shàng le běi jīng dà xué
en: She got into Peking University.
why: Reaching a goal is verb + 上, with 了 after it and no 来/去: 考上了北京大学. 考起 does not exist in this sense.

s: 你得把症状写下去，医生要看。
s_py: nǐ děi bǎ zhèng zhuàng xiě xià qù yī shēng yào kàn
zh: 你得把症状写下来，医生要看。
py: nǐ děi bǎ zhèng zhuàng xiě xià lái yī shēng yào kàn
en: You have to write your symptoms down; the doctor wants to see them.
why: Fixing something on paper is 写下来. 写下去 means to keep on writing.

q: 办公室里只剩我一个人，同事们都跑出___吃午饭了。
zh: 办公室里只剩我一个人，同事们都跑出办公室去吃午饭了。
py: bàn gōng shì lǐ zhǐ shèng wǒ yī gè rén tóng shì men dōu pǎo chū bàn gōng shì qù chī wǔ fàn le
en: Only I am left in the office; my colleagues have all run out to lunch.
why: The place goes before 去: 跑出办公室去. They leave away from me, so 去, not 来, and the place cannot follow 去.

zh: 车在医院门口停下来了。
py: chē zài yī yuàn mén kǒu tíng xià lái le
en: The car stopped at the hospital gate.
why: 停下来 is a coming to rest, and the 在 phrase comes before the verb. 停下去 would mean to keep stopping, which makes no sense.

s: 你看起来有点儿累，是不是没睡好？
s_py: nǐ kàn qǐ lái yǒu diǎn r lèi shì bú shì méi shuì hǎo
zh: 你看起来有点儿累，是不是没睡好？
py: nǐ kàn qǐ lái yǒu diǎn r lèi shì bú shì méi shuì hǎo
en: You look a bit tired; didn't you sleep well?
why: An impression is 看起来 + comment. 看出来 would mean you had worked something out.

q: 这个新办法是我们团队花了三个月才想___的。
zh: 这个新办法是我们团队花了三个月才想出来的。
py: zhè ge xīn bàn fǎ shì wǒ men tuán duì huā le sān gè yuè cái xiǎng chū lái de
en: This new method is something our team spent three months coming up with.
why: Creating something that did not exist is 想出来. 想起来 is recalling what you already knew, and the method was only just made.

q: 这件白大褂穿___有点儿大。
zh: 这件白大褂穿起来有点儿大。
py: zhè jiàn bái dà guà chuān qǐ lái yǒu diǎn r dà
en: This white coat is a bit big when you wear it.
why: How something feels in use is verb + 起来 + comment: 穿起来有点儿大. The other endings do not introduce a judgement.

s: 我在一楼，你下来吧，我们一起去吃饭。
s_py: wǒ zài yī lóu nǐ xià lái ba wǒ men yī qǐ qù chī fàn
zh: 我在一楼，你下来吧，我们一起去吃饭。
py: wǒ zài yī lóu nǐ xià lái ba wǒ men yī qǐ qù chī fàn
en: I'm on the ground floor, so come down and let's go and eat together.
why: The speaker is downstairs, so 下来 is right. The 去 in 去吃饭 is a separate verb 'go', not a direction word.

q: 天冷了，出门要穿___厚外套。
zh: 天冷了，出门要穿上厚外套。
py: tiān lěng le chū mén yào chuān shàng hòu wài tào
en: It's getting cold; put on a thick coat when you go out.
why: Putting a garment on is 穿上 with no 来/去. 穿下 does not exist and 穿起 only occurs in 穿起来.

s: 天冷了，你多穿上一件衣服吧。
s_py: tiān lěng le nǐ duō chuān shàng yī jiàn yī fu ba
zh: 天冷了，你多穿上一件衣服吧。
py: tiān lěng le nǐ duō chuān shàng yī jiàn yī fu ba
en: It's getting cold; put on another layer.
why: 穿上 'put on' takes no 来/去 and can have a counted object right after it.

s: 医生从包里拿来出一支笔。
s_py: yī shēng cóng bāo lǐ ná lái chū yī zhī bǐ
zh: 医生从包里拿出一支笔来。
py: yī shēng cóng bāo lǐ ná chū yī zhī bǐ lái
en: The doctor took a pen out of his bag.
why: The direction word comes right after the verb and 来 follows it: 拿出, then 来. Putting 来 before 出 scrambles the parts.

q: 经理正从马路对面走___来。
zh: 经理正从马路对面走过来。
py: jīng lǐ zhèng cóng mǎ lù duì miàn zǒu guò lái
en: The manager is walking over from the other side of the road.
why: Crossing from the opposite side is 过: 走过来. 起 only means rising, and 上 or 下 need a higher or lower place.

q: 王医生不在医院，他已经回___了。
zh: 王医生不在医院，他已经回去了。
py: wáng yī shēng bú zài yī yuàn tā yǐ jīng huí qù le
en: Dr Wang isn't at the hospital; he has already gone back.
why: He is no longer where I am, so the movement was away from here: 回去. 回来 would mean he is back at this hospital.

src_py: tā chuān le bái dà guà
task: Say she put it on (use 上).
zh: 她穿上了白大褂。
py: tā chuān shàng le bái dà guà
en: She put on the white coat.
why: Putting on clothing is 穿上, with 了 after it and no 来/去.

q: 这份报告是小王一个人写___的，没有别人帮忙。
zh: 这份报告是小王一个人写出来的，没有别人帮忙。
py: zhè fèn bào gào shì xiǎo wáng yī gè rén xiě chū lái de méi yǒu bié rén bāng máng
en: Xiao Wang produced this report all by himself, with no help from anyone.
why: Bringing a piece of work into being is 写出来. 写下来 means putting something already known on paper, and 起来 would mean starting.

q: 护士推着病人从电梯里走___来了。
zh: 护士推着病人从电梯里走出来了。
py: hù shi tuī zhe bìng rén cóng diàn tī lǐ zǒu chū lái le
en: The nurse came out of the lift pushing the patient.
why: Leaving a lift (a container) is 出: 走出来. 走进来 would mean walking into it, and 从电梯里 shows the starting point is inside.

zh: 开会时我把重点记下来了。
py: kāi huì shí wǒ bǎ zhòng diǎn jì xià lái le
en: I wrote down the key points during the meeting.
why: Fixing something on paper is 记下来, kept together after 把重点. 记下去 would mean to keep on noting.

q: 她从抽屉里拿___。
zh: 她从抽屉里拿出一份文件来。
py: tā cóng chōu ti lǐ ná chū yī fèn wén jiàn lái
en: She took a document out of the drawer.
why: A thing object sits between 出 and 来 (拿出一份文件来). The three parts verb, direction and 来 cannot be scrambled around the object.

src_py: wǒ bǎ shǒu jī dài lái le
zh: 我没把手机带来。
py: wǒ méi bǎ shǒu jī dài lái
en: I didn't bring my phone.
why: The negative 没 goes before 把, never after it, and 了 drops out because 没 already says it did not happen.

q: 我已经在会议室里了，你快进___吧。
zh: 我已经在会议室里了，你快进来吧。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng zài huì yì shì lǐ le nǐ kuài jìn lái ba
en: I'm already in the meeting room, so come in quickly.
why: I am inside, so entering moves toward me: 进来. 进去 would suit someone standing outside and watching the listener go in.

q: 他不在公司了，已经回___了。
zh: 他不在公司了，已经回家去了。
py: tā bú zài gōng sī le yǐ jīng huí jiā qù le
en: He's no longer at the company; he has already gone home.
why: A place sits between the direction word and 去: 回家去. 回去家 and 回来家 put it after 来/去, and 家来 points toward the speaker at the company.

q: 老板一进办公室，大家都站___来了。
zh: 老板一进办公室，大家都站起来了。
py: lǎo bǎn yī jìn bàn gōng shì dà jiā dōu zhàn qǐ lái le
en: As soon as the boss walked into the office, everyone stood up.
why: Rising from a seat is 站起来: 起 pairs with 来 for rising on the spot. 站上来 would mean stepping up onto something.

src_py: qǐng nǐ zài shuō wǒ men dōu zài tīng
zh: 请你说下去，我们都在听。
py: qǐng nǐ shuō xià qù wǒ men dōu zài tīng
en: Please go on, we are all listening.
why: Carrying on with something already under way is 说下去. 说起来 would be starting, and 下去 takes no object.

q: 他的名字我忘了，刚才在路上突然想___来了。
zh: 他的名字我忘了，刚才在路上突然想起来了。
py: tā de míng zi wǒ wàng le gāng cái zài lù shàng tū rán xiǎng qǐ lái le
en: I'd forgotten his name, but it suddenly came back to me on the road just now.
why: Recalling a name you once knew is 想起来. 想出来 is for working out or inventing something new, not for retrieving a forgotten name.

q: 我躺在病房里，医生走进___了。
zh: 我躺在病房里，医生走进病房来了。
py: wǒ tǎng zài bìng fáng lǐ yī shēng zǒu jìn bìng fáng lái le
en: I was lying in the ward when the doctor walked in.
why: 病房 must sit before 来, and the doctor comes toward me in the ward, so 来. 走进来病房 puts the place after 来, and 去 points away from me.

q: 护士给我端___。
zh: 护士给我端来一杯热水。
py: hù shi gěi wǒ duān lái yī bēi rè shuǐ
en: The nurse brought me a cup of hot water.
why: After the verb 端 comes 来 and then the new object: 端来一杯热水. The measure phrase stays attached to 热水 and cannot be split from it.

zh: 护士拿出一片药来。
py: hù shi ná chū yī piàn yào lái
en: The nurse took out a tablet.
why: A thing object may go before or after 来, so both 拿出一片药来 and 拿出来一片药 are right. 来 cannot go before 出.

q: 老板把客人带___了。
zh: 老板把客人带进会议室去了。
py: lǎo bǎn bǎ kè rén dài jìn huì yì shì qù le
en: The boss took the guests into the meeting room.
why: With a place, 去 closes the phrase: 带进会议室去. 带进去会议室 puts the place after 去, and the other options scramble the order.

q: 他从包里拿___一份文件来。
zh: 他从包里拿出一份文件来。
py: tā cóng bāo lǐ ná chū yī fèn wén jiàn lái
en: He took a document out of his bag.
why: Something coming out of a bag is 出. 进, 上 and 回 do not describe leaving a container.

q: 电脑在一楼，同事帮我把它搬___三楼去了。
zh: 电脑在一楼，同事帮我把它搬上三楼去了。
py: diàn nǎo zài yī lóu tóng shì bāng wǒ bǎ tā bān shàng sān lóu qù le
en: The computer was on the ground floor, and a colleague helped me carry it up to the third floor.
why: From the ground floor to the third floor is upward: 上. The place 三楼 sits between 上 and 去 even inside a 把 sentence.

q: 你站了一上午了，快坐___来休息一下。
zh: 你站了一上午了，快坐下来休息一下。
py: nǐ zhàn le yī shàng wǔ le kuài zuò xià lái xiū xi yī xià
en: You've been on your feet all morning, so sit down and rest a bit.
why: Going from standing to sitting is 坐下来. 坐起来 means sitting up from lying down, which does not fit someone who has been standing.
